# x402 Jaccard Similarity

> Deterministic set-based similarity (Jaccard + Dice) for agents. Tokenize two strings or accept pre-tokenized arrays. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/jaccard
  - Input: `{ "a": string|string[], "b": string|string[], "tokenize"?: "word"|"char" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "jaccard": number, "dice": number, "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.006 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure set math
- Ideal for fuzzy matching, deduplication, memory similarity gating, and ranking candidates
- Lightweight and high-frequency safe
